title: Tech Workshop 2024
description: Join us for an exciting workshop on the latest technology trends and hands-on projects.
excerpt: An interactive workshop covering emerging technologies and practical applications.
content: This comprehensive workshop will cover topics including AI, machine learning, IoT, and more. Participants will work on hands-on projects and learn from industry experts.

title: IEEE Day Celebration
description: Celebrating IEEE Day with the student community.
excerpt: A day of celebration, networking, and learning about IEEE activities.
content: IEEE Day is celebrated around the world to commemorate the first time in history that engineers worldwide gathered to share their technical ideas in 1884.

title: Robotics Competition
excerpt: Showcase your robotics skills in this exciting competition.
content: Teams of students will compete in various robotics challenges. Prizes will be awarded to top performers.
